# LNS Maintenance Services

> Residential and commercial cleaning company serving Werribee and Melbourne's west (City of Wyndham), plus the regional cities of Geelong and Ballarat, VIC. Owner: Shenal. Google 4.7-star (10 reviews), HiPages 4.5-star (46 verified recommendations). Open 7 days, 7am-11pm. 100% satisfaction guarantee with a bond-back re-clean guarantee on end of lease cleans.

LNS Maintenance Services provides 11 professional cleaning services across Werribee (3030), Wyndham Vale (3024), Hoppers Crossing (3029), Point Cook (3030), Tarneit (3029), Truganina (3029), Williams Landing (3027) and Manor Lakes (3024) in Melbourne's west, plus the regional cities of Geelong (3220) and Ballarat (3350), Victoria, Australia. All services use eco-friendly products and trained local cleaners. Free fixed-price quotes, usually returned within one business day.

## Contact

- Phone: +61 424 120 509

## Services

- [End of Lease Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/end-of-lease.html): Bond-back guaranteed end-of-tenancy clean built around the property manager's exit checklist. Oven and rangehood degrease, carpet steam clean, window tracks and sills, wall mark removal, cupboards inside and out.
- [House & Regular Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/house-cleaning.html): Weekly, fortnightly or monthly home cleaning with the same trusted cleaner each visit.
- [Deep, Spring & Pre-Sale Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/deep-cleaning.html): Top-to-bottom intensive clean to refresh, reset or prepare a home for sale.
- [Carpet Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/carpet-cleaning.html): Hot-water steam extraction and dry methods. Stain and pet-odour treatment, fast dry times.
- [Window Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/window-cleaning.html): Streak-free internal and external glass, frames, tracks and sills.
- [NDIS & Aged Care Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/ndis-aged-care.html): Cleaning for NDIS participants and seniors. Plan-friendly invoicing, consistent vetted cleaners, low-tox products, dignity-first approach.
- [Office & Commercial Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/office-cleaning.html): Daily or weekly cleaning for offices, retail and commercial spaces.
- [Builders / Post-Construction Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/builders-cleaning.html): Post-construction clean for new builds and renovations — fine dust, residue, finishing and site reset.
- [Medical & Childcare Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/medical-cleaning.html): Infection-control cleaning for clinics, childcare centres and healthcare sites.
- [Warehouse & Industrial Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/warehouse-cleaning.html): Large-format cleaning for warehouses, factories and industrial units.
- [Strata & Common Area Cleaning](https://www.lnsmaintenanceservices.com.au/services/strata-cleaning.html): Scheduled cleaning for apartment blocks, lobbies, stairwells and shared spaces.
